title: Master of Revenants
problem: Heal inside an ally loop: maybe healed once per ally.
notes: Fix: S User 2026-10-26: each Revenant (party of 6 Revenants) heals 50% once at the end of its own turn; the code heals once per ally (the loop element is unused). Fix: heal once. | 2026-10-26 hook batch F1 built (research/hooks_F1.json, loader/hooks_F1.c). bc_CreatureEndOfTurn's Master of Revenants block runs inside a party loop and healed on every pass; the non-matching branch (L1115) now jumps to the loop's continue, so only one pass heals: each Revenant heals 50% once at the end of its own turn. In-game test: all-Revenant party with Master of Revenants; damage one Revenant, end its turn: one heal of 50% of its Health (not one per party member).

release_notes.intended: Each Revenant heals 50% at the end of its own turn.
release_notes.actual: The game healed once for every creature in the party.
release_notes.fix: Now each Revenant heals once, at the end of its own turn.
